title: Results – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: The page provides the official 2026 results at results.chicagomarathon.com/2026/.
The event says it has welcomed more than one million runners across its finish line since its founding in 1977.
Online historic results are available from 1993–2019 and 2021–2025.
Age-group awards cover men, women and non-binary divisions from 16–19 through 80 and over.
The page does not restate the course distance or publish an elevation figure.
